reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR on the box, and I would scan it before checking out to see a real named lab report. The sachets are handy for travel, and a one-time $30 trial is easy to justify, but I would keep my current magnesium as a backup until I trust this one.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A lab report is better than nothing, but it is the brand's own report, and I can't tell whether it is a real batch or a cherry-picked one. I also already have a magnesium that works for me.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification, or a QR report that opens on a real, dated, batch-specific lab document with the lab's name, plus a handful of verified reviews.
